description: Calculate a Western natal birth chart (tropical zodiac, Placidus houses): Sun, Moon and Rising signs, planets in signs and houses, and the tightest major aspects. Requires exact birth date, local birth time, IANA time zone and birthplace coordinates.

birth_time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, HH:MM (24h). Ask the user if unknown — do not guess.

dst_fold.description: Only when the birth time falls in a daylight-saving fall-back hour

place.description: Birthplace name, e.g. New York, USA

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Kolkata

name: get_birth_chart
title: Natal Birth Chart
